'''Koyi Mateil''' was a wealthy [[Twi'lek]] [[duchess]]<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref> who was the [[Marriage|wife]] of the old<ref name="Die Wanna Wanga" /> [[human]]<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> Duke [[Teta (duke)|Teta]]. She secretly hoped for her husband to die so that she could inherit his fortune. Together with Teta, Mateil visited the<ref name="Die Wanna Wanga" /> [[Galaxies Opera House]] in the [[Uscru District]] of the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> in the [[Standard year|year]] [[19 BBY]]<ref name="Timelines">{{FilmDate|III}}</ref> during a performance of the [[opera]] ''[[Squid Lake]]''.<ref name="USW" /> The two were walking up the opera house's steps in front of<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> the [[human]] [[Ulfor Bombaasa]] and [[alien]] [[Opula Deget]]<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> when the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] ran past them on his way to meet with [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]].<ref name="ROTS" /> Mateil had [[Color|orange]] skin and brown [[eye]]s. The Twi'lek was wearing a bejewelled white [[Clothing|dress]] and a silver headpiece on the night of the opera.<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Koyi Mateil first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> which released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="YBY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> The opera steps scene was filmed on R Stage at [[Shepperton Studios]] as part of additional photography on Monday, [[August 23]], [[2004]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> Mateil's costume consisted of a Jersey evening dress with a beaded bodice.<ref name="Dressing">''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''</ref>

In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character's name was first used by the article "Die Wanna Wanga: Encounters of The Twi'lek Kind", written by [[Tim Veekhoven]] and posted on [[StarWars.com]] on [[August 19]], [[2014]].<ref name="Die Wanna Wanga" /> The name originated in ''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]'', a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] reference book written by [[Trisha Biggar]]<ref name="Dressing">''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''</ref> and released on [[October 11]], 2005.<ref name="DressingDate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.waterstones.com/book/dressing-a-galaxy-part-1/trisha-biggar/george-lucas/9780810959644|text=Dressing a Galaxy: Part 1: The Costumes of Star Wars (Hardback)|work=[[Wikipedia:Waterstones|Waterstones]]|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/mxQvt|archivedate=2022-04-24}}</ref>
